custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'mushiness' of the carved details. In real stone carving, edges are sharp even if weathered. AI often smears these details. Also, verify if the shadow under the altar is consistent with the light coming from the windows; inconsistent shadows can indicate compositing or generation errors.
image_description: A high-angle, eye-level shot of an ornate stone altar in a church sanctuary. The altar features a white marble top slab draped with a white cloth on the right side, supported by a heavily carved golden-brown stone base with intricate relief patterns. Behind the altar is a wooden reredos with Gothic-style tracery and three stained-glass windows. A bronze tabernacle sits on the center of the altar, flanked by tall candlesticks.
